event: US October CPI, today Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Sharp drop
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,083 at 11:39 SAST, down about 56 (1.4%) on the day after a high of 4,147 (Kitco); Trading Economics shows 4,088-4,095, so the exact price is UNVERIFIED within a few dollars.

bullets.title: 4,106 broken
bullets.text: Price fell through the 4,106 support from this morning and is now testing the 4,079-4,088 area (Kitco, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Hike odds 84%
bullets.text: Markets price about 84% odds of a December Fed hike, up from about 74% a week ago, which weighs on gold (Trading Economics, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Dollar flat
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.6 and the US 10-year yield near 4.86-4.89%, both roughly flat, so the selling is not dollar-led (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: CPI decides today
bullets.text: October CPI is expected at +0.3% m/m headline and +0.2% core; a hot number can push gold toward 4,050, a soft one can lift it back to 4,106-4,114 (TradingKey).

bullets.title: Buyers underneath
bullets.text: Central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3 and China added about 25.8 tonnes in October, which supports dips over the longer term (FXEmpire).

levels.note: FXEmpire S1 4,079.30; bottom of TradingKey 4,100-4,085 zone just above

buy.title: Buy plan (counter-trend): dip that holds 4,050
look: This is counter-trend: the bias is down, so use half size.
A dip into 4,050-4,055 that closes back up on the 15M.
A soft CPI at 15:30 SAST that turns gold up.
Wait until 15 minutes after CPI before entering.
watch: Buying at 4,084 because it looks cheap, with no zone and no stop.
A hot CPI can drive gold through 4,040 in minutes.
Fed hike odds near 84% can keep sellers in control after a bounce.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 4,100-4,106
look: A bounce into 4,100-4,106 that fails, not a sell at 4,084 near support.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index turning up from 101.6.
If you are in before CPI, take some profit or tighten by 15:15 SAST.
watch: A soft CPI can squeeze sellers through 4,118 toward 4,147.
Oil falling on US-Iran peace hopes can cool inflation fears and help gold.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
